headline.missing_disposition: This task's run finished, but no next step was chosen. Choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
headline.deliberate_wait_without_target: This task's last run stopped to wait, but there is no reviewer, blocker, monitor, or approval to wait for. Paperclip is repairing the next step; the task stays with its owner.
headline.stranded_assigned_issue: Paperclip retried this task's last run, but there is still no queued run, reviewer, blocker, or other next owner. To get it moving, choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
headline.workspace_validation: Paperclip stopped this run because the task's git workspace could not be validated.
headline.configuration_validation: Paperclip stopped before dispatching this run because required secret/env bindings are missing.
headline.active_run_watchdog: The active run has been silent. Recovery is observing without interrupting it.
headline.issue_graph_liveness: Paperclip could not find a clear next step for this open task. Choose whether to continue work, send it for review, mark it done, or record what is blocking it.

contention.after: — the lossless repair can't run while another workspace holds the live branch.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass reconciliation
breakGlass.descriptionBefore: This overrides Paperclip's safety check and points the recorded workspace at the live branch
breakGlass.descriptionAfter: . Confirm the divergence below and record why before continuing.
breakGlass.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Verified the live branch carries only the intended follow-up commits; safe to adopt.

repair.trigger: Repair workspace — quarantine changes & restore branch
repair.title: Repair workspace
repair.description: This is lossless — no reason required. Your uncommitted changes are committed onto a fresh rescue branch, then the recorded branch is restored so the task can resume. The live branch is left exactly as it is.
repair.heldByReissue: Held by {{label}} — re-issue on an isolated workspace instead.

wake.wakeOwner: An agent will be asked to choose the next step
wake.boundedOwnerRepair: Paperclip is retrying the original owner
wake.boundedRecoveryOwner: An agent is choosing the next step
wake.retryExpired: The scheduled retry did not run — a retry or a decision is needed
wake.exhausted: Automatic retries are finished — a decision is needed

nativeRun.live: Paperclip is recovering the existing run.
nativeRun.exhausted: Paperclip could not recover the existing run within its retry budget. Review the recorded failure before retrying.
nativeRun.retryExpired: The retry for the existing run came due and did not start. Review the recorded failure and retry when ready.
nativeRun.scheduled: Paperclip has scheduled another attempt to resume the existing run.
nativeRun.needsRecovery: The existing run still needs recovery. Review the recorded failure before retrying.

lineage.retryExpired: This task's automatic retry came due and did not run, so nothing is moving it forward right now. Someone must retry it or record the next step.

sourceOwner.exhausted: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. The original owner has used every automatic repair attempt, so the next step needs a decision. The task stays with its owner.
sourceOwner.retrying: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. Paperclip is retrying the original owner to record a real next step. The task stays with its owner, and no action is needed yet.

lineage.recoveryOwner: The original owner could not record a next step within its retry budget. A recovery owner is now repairing the path only — the task itself still belongs to its original owner.
lineage.board: Automatic recovery is exhausted, so the board must choose the next step. The task itself still belongs to its original owner.

todo.label: Try again
todo.description: Dismiss recovery and return the source task to todo.

done.label: Mark task done
done.description: Restore by recording the requested work as complete.

in_review.label: Send for review
in_review.description: Hand off to a reviewer with a real review path.

false_positive_done.label: False positive, done
false_positive_done.description: Dismiss recovery and mark the source task complete.

false_positive_in_review.label: False positive, review
false_positive_in_review.description: Dismiss recovery and send the source task for review.

humanDecisionHeadline: This recovery needs a human decision. Review the recorded failure and choose the next step.

meta.unassignedPick: unassigned — pick one to wake them
meta.ownerUsedAttempts: The original owner used {{used}} of {{max}} automatic attempts.

reissue.title: Re-issue on isolated workspace
reissue.description: Creates a fresh copy of this task on an isolated git worktree based on the live branch. Your current workspace and its commits are left untouched.

footer.observing: Recovery is observing without interrupting the live run.
footer.staysOpen: The card stays open until an explicit decision is recorded.

containment.confirmError: Confirm both original-host stops and review the action outcomes.
containment.title: Verify the original execution stopped
containment.description: Paperclip cannot compare process IDs across hosts or kernel sessions. Stop both the controller and provider on the original host before recording evidence. The saved lease must also expire and environment/workspace cleanup must finish. Recording containment does not retry the task.
containment.controllerStopped: I verified the original controller stopped on its original host.
containment.providerStopped: I verified the original provider and its tools stopped on their original host.
containment.outcomePlaceholder: Select only after reviewing the effects
containment.outcomeMixed: Some completed and some not performed
containment.evidenceLabel: Original-host containment evidence and actions that must not be repeated
containment.unknownHint: If any action outcome is still unknown, keep this hold. After evidence and cleanup settle, use the task’s ordinary Retry action separately.
containment.needsAdmin: A company owner, company administrator, or instance administrator must review this original-host execution.
